products.title: Business Cards
products.summary: A contact card with the right weight, texture and finish for the way you network.
products.description: Business cards should feel like the conversation that follows them. Choose a sturdy everyday stock, a velvet-soft ivory, a matte sheet with selective gloss highlights, or a tactile linen weave, then match the finish to the personality of your brand. Every option is trimmed cleanly and prepared for double-sided colour.
features: Four tactile stocks for different brand personalities
Crisp colour and clean edge trimming
Packed for handouts, desks and networking

variants.name: Standard
variants.description: The everyday premium choice: a sturdy 300gsm sheet with a clean matte or gloss surface, built for high-volume networking without a bulky feel.

variants.name: Premium
variants.description: A heavier ivory sheet with soft-touch lamination gives your details a quiet, velvet-like presence for clients and partners who notice the finish.

variants.name: Spot-UV
variants.description: A matte base with selective gloss UV lets a logo, name or graphic catch the light while the rest of the card stays understated and tactile.

variants.name: Textured
variants.description: A woven linen texture adds a physical signature to every introduction, making the card feel considered before a single word is read.
features: Ideal for creative and hospitality brands

products.title: Flyers & Leaflets
products.summary: A size and finish for every handout, from compact A6 promos to DL folded menus.
products.description: Flyers work best when the format matches the moment. Use A6 for compact offers, A5 for bold event promotion, or a scored DL bi-fold for menus, programmes and information that needs a little more room. Each format is printed in full colour, trimmed cleanly and priced around its paper footprint.

specifications.label: Trim
specifications.value: Cut to final format after printing

features: Size-led pricing for predictable campaign budgets
Double-sided colour with clean edge trimming
Flat and bi-fold formats for different audiences
Bulk runs packed and finished by format

variants.name: A5 Gloss
variants.description: A5 gloss gives promotions enough space for a strong headline, supporting copy and a clear call to action while keeping the sheet light enough for high-volume distribution.
features: Efficient for event and retail drops

variants.name: A6 Matte
variants.description: A6 matte is a compact, understated format for vouchers, quick announcements and takeaway messages. The heavier sheet feels deliberate while the matte surface keeps text easy to read.
features: Ideal for vouchers and quick updates

variants.name: DL Folded
variants.description: A scored DL bi-fold turns one sheet into a compact sequence of panels, making it a practical choice for menus, service lists and event programmes that need a clear reading order.
features: Scored bi-fold for an organized layout
Gloss surface for food and event imagery

products.title: Branded Tote & Paper Bags
products.material: Cotton, kraft, art paper, non-woven PP or jute
products.summary: A reusable brand carrier for every channel, from cotton totes to ribbon-handled gift bags.
products.description: A bag keeps working after the sale. Choose cotton for a durable everyday tote, kraft for a recyclable retail default, art paper with ribbon handles for gifting, non-woven polypropylene for lightweight events, or natural jute for a textured premium feel. The print method follows the material so your logo stays legible and appropriate.

specifications.label: Print area
specifications.value: Front and back panels where applicable

features: Five substrates with distinct handling and brand feel
Logo placement planned around each bag shape
Reusable formats for retail, events and gifting
Print method matched to material and order volume

variants.name: Cotton Tote
variants.description: A heavyweight cotton tote is made for repeat use, with enough surface area for a confident logo and the durability to become part of someone's daily routine.
features: Strong logo presence on a reusable bag
Ideal for retail and lifestyle brands

variants.name: Kraft Paper Bag
variants.description: Kraft paper gives everyday retail a natural, responsible look. It is a practical carrier for boutiques, markets and takeaway purchases, with full-colour branding available on the front panel.
features: Twisted paper handles for easy carrying

variants.name: Premium Gift Bag
variants.description: A structured art-paper bag with ribbon handles turns packaging into part of the gift. Full-colour artwork or foil stamping can make the unboxing moment feel intentionally premium.
features: Designed for gifting and premium retail

variants.name: Non-Woven Bag
variants.description: Non-woven polypropylene is light to store, easy to carry and practical for conferences, activations and high-volume giveaways where the bag needs to travel well.
features: Folds flat for storage and transport

variants.name: Jute Bag
variants.description: Natural jute brings a coarse, earthy texture and a strong visual identity to a reusable carrier. Its character suits markets, hospitality and brands that want their packaging to feel distinct.
features: Reusable carrier for premium casual use

products.title: Roll-Up Banners
products.summary: A fast, portable display that turns a corner, counter or booth into a branded focal point.
products.description: Roll-up banners are built for moments when you need presence without a permanent installation. A block-out graphic rises from a compact aluminium base, gives your message a tall viewing area, and packs back into a carry case for the next venue.
features: Tool-free aluminium base and telescopic pole
Protective carry case sized to each format
Compact setup for counters, aisles and exhibition stands

variants.name: Standard 85cm
variants.description: The 85cm format is the compact workhorse for reception areas, product counters and exhibition aisles, giving you a tall message without taking over the floor plan.
features: Carry case included for repeat use

variants.name: Premium 100cm
variants.description: The 100cm format adds valuable visual width for trade-show graphics, product ranges and bold brand statements while retaining the same portable roll-up hardware.
features: Carry case sized for the wider format

products.title: Stickers & Labels
products.summary: Shape, stick and stay visible with custom vinyl labels made for packaging and promotions.
products.description: Stickers turn packaging, windows and campaign materials into small branded surfaces. Supply a contour-ready artwork and choose white vinyl for a bold label or clear vinyl for a no-background finish, then select gloss, matte or transparent surface treatment.
features: Contour cutting follows your artwork outline
Permanent adhesive for packaging, windows and promotions
Gloss, matte or clear surface options
Individual pieces supplied ready to peel and apply

variants.name: Die-cut Vinyl
variants.description: Die-cut vinyl follows the outline of your artwork, so logos, characters and product marks can leave the sheet as individual shapes rather than sitting inside a rectangle.
features: Permanent adhesive for packaging and promotions

variants.name: Transparent Vinyl
variants.description: Clear vinyl lets the surface beneath the label become part of the design, creating a floating, no-background look for bottles, jars, windows and glass displays.
features: Ideal for transparent packaging and windows

products.title: Brochures & Catalogues
products.summary: Turn a product range or service story into a tactile piece people can browse at their own pace.
products.description: Brochures give detailed information a physical rhythm. A tri-fold is ideal for a concise service story or countertop handout, while a saddle-stitched catalogue carries more pages for ranges, portfolios and company profiles. Both use 170gsm silk art paper for crisp imagery and a substantial page turn.
features: Folded or bound formats matched to content depth
Silk art paper balances colour detail and page stiffness
Ideal for ranges, service menus and company profiles

variants.name: Tri-fold
variants.description: A single A4 sheet folded into three panels gives a service or product story a clear sequence while remaining compact enough for counters, mailers and handbags.
features: Precision score lines for a clean fold

variants.name: Saddle-stitch
variants.description: A5 saddle-stitch binding turns multiple pages into a compact catalogue or portfolio, with a stitched spine that keeps product ranges and longer stories together neatly.
features: Stitched spine for a clean profile
Ideal for ranges and company profiles

products.title: Posters
products.summary: Large, vivid prints for walls, windows and short-run campaigns, finished for the way they will be seen.
products.description: Posters need to work from a distance and up close. A2 gloss maximizes colour impact for events and retail windows, while A1 matte keeps text and imagery readable under bright lights. Both are printed on 200gsm photo paper and trimmed to a standard A-series size.
features: Photo-grade colour for artwork, events and retail displays
Gloss for saturated colour, matte for low-glare viewing

variants.name: A2 Gloss
variants.description: A2 gloss gives bold artwork and promotional imagery a saturated, eye-catching surface for windows, noticeboards and short-run event displays.
features: Gloss surface for high colour impact
Ready for windows and indoor boards

variants.name: A1 Matte
variants.description: A1 matte keeps large text and detailed imagery readable in bright spaces, making it the practical choice for presentations, exhibitions and information-led displays.

products.title: Large Format Printing
products.material: Outdoor PVC flex or self-adhesive vinyl
products.summary: Custom-scale graphics for storefronts, sites and events, finished for the way they will be installed.
products.description: Large-format printing turns the dimensions of your space into the dimensions of your message. Choose PVC flex for a standalone banner with eyelets or hemming, or self-adhesive vinyl for a graphic that becomes part of a window, wall or site surface.

specifications.label: Artwork
specifications.value: Scaled PDF or vector at final size

features: Made to the exact dimensions of your space
Eyelets, hemming or adhesive backing selected by installation
Suitable for storefronts, events and site graphics

variants.name: Flex Banner
variants.description: PVC flex is a durable, flexible banner material for storefronts, events and site signage. Eyelets and hemmed edges make it ready for ropes, frames or other fixings specified for the installation.
features: Suitable for storefronts and temporary sites

variants.name: Vinyl Sticker
variants.description: Self-adhesive vinyl turns a window, wall or smooth site surface into a branded graphic. Choose gloss for colour presence or matte for a lower-glare finish, with the graphic printed to the measured dimensions.
features: Ideal for windows, walls and site graphics

specifications.label: Best for
specifications.value: Windows, walls and applied site graphics
